source.title: MIMS Abbreviation Index + common prescription/dispensing shorthand
source.note: MIMS Abbreviation Index (© MIMS) plus widely-used Malaysian/Commonwealth prescription Latin shorthand. Use ONLY to DECODE abbreviations that are actually written on the label/prescription. Never invent a value that is not written. If a mark is unclear or illegible, use 'Not readable'. Expand to the full meaning and also keep the original shorthand in brackets, e.g. '2 tablets (TT)'.

misc.x: for (duration), e.g. x 7 days = for 7 days
misc.mdu: to be used as directed (more dicto utendus)

mims_index_note: The full MIMS Abbreviation Index (bd/bid=twice daily, tds/tid=three times daily, qds/qid=four times daily, prn, po, SR/XR/ER=extended-release, EC=enteric-coated, cap=capsule, tab=tablet, susp=suspension, soln=solution, inj=injection, mcg=microgram, etc.) also applies when decoding product/form abbreviations on the label.
